method: random.Random(125); sample KC-P(8), then KC-L(4), then ST(10), in that order, each from the sorted ID list

ST.id_field: OBJECTID (FACILID recorded; null FACILID means no stable ID)

claims_tested.KC: The rule an adapter would derive from the layer record plus Metro's published system policy: parking open to transit customers, no charge, first come first served, any hour, maximum stay 72 hours, at the layer point.
claims_tested.ST: The rule an adapter would derive from the polygon plus Sound Transit's published system policy: open to transit passengers 24 hours a day, maximum stay 24 hours, no charge outside the station permit areas listed on the parking page, within the polygon.

independent_signals: The operator's own per-lot listing or facility page: Metro's parking-locations entry for the lot; Sound Transit's facility page under /ride-with-us/parking/parking-locations/ or the station page.
Where a different public operator owns or runs the lot, that operator's own official page for the lot (for example Sound Transit for a Metro-listed station garage).
Location: published coordinates in the operator's map link where present, otherwise the published street address compared with the layer address.

contradiction_if: an independent official signal states a fee, permit-only or reserved area, eligibility, time window, closure or maximum stay for the lot that differs from or is absent from the tested claim
the independent signal says no transit-customer parking exists, or the lot is not listed as an operating facility
published coordinates are more than 150 m from the layer point (KC) or outside the polygon by more than 150 m (ST), or the published address names a different site
contradiction_rule.unknown_if: no independent official per-lot signal can be retrieved; Unknown counts as not confirmed, never as a pass
contradiction_rule.pass_threshold: zero contradictions across all drawn lots, and zero Unknown

KC_P.name: Auburn Surface Lot at Auburn Station P&R

disclosure: Before registration the author fetched, for discovery only, Metro's parking-locations and regulations pages, Sound Transit's parking and parking-locations pages, and the Eastgate facility page. These are re-fetched after registration for the spot check.
